title: Logos 4 opening: against “there was when the Son was not”
english: Fourth discourse. Against those who dare to say, “There was when the Son was not.”

Selections of syllogisms and constructions of thoughts with testimonies; the conclusion from all: the Word of God is eternal. Romans 1:20 and other witnesses are pressed so that “eternal power and deity” are not stripped from the Son.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
After Logos I rem; earliest-forward Logos 4.
